sectionHeading: From brief to launch in four clear steps

steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.description: We start with a free 20-minute call to understand your goals, budget, and timeline. No jargon, no hard sell.

steps.title: Strategy & Proposal
steps.description: Within 48 hours we send a detailed scope of work, timeline, and fixed price. You know exactly what you're getting before we start.

steps.title: Design & Build
steps.description: Weekly progress updates, regular previews, and a direct line to your team. You're involved at every stage, not just the beginning and end.

steps.title: Launch & Support
steps.description: We handle deployment, testing, and go-live. Then 30 days of free support so you're never left stranded after launch.
